title: Verify loyalty currency balance consistency after earning points
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty Currency Consistency
  Scenario: User loyalty balance remains consistent after earning points
    Given a user has an initial loyalty balance of 100 points
    When the user completes a transaction earning 50 points
    Then the loyalty balance should be updated to 150 points
    And the balance should be consistent across all system views
    And the transaction should be recorded in the loyalty history
rationale: Ensures that loyalty currency balances are accurately updated and remain consistent across the system when points are earned through transactions.
generationSummary: Loyalty currency consistency requirement ensures that loyalty currency values, calculations, and representations remain consistent across all system operations and user interactions. This includes maintaining accurate balances, consistent conversion rates, proper transaction recording, and uniform display of loyalty currency throughout the application.
